تزدردي (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرِدِي (tazdaridī) /taz.da.ri.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# تُزْدَرَدِي (tuzdaradī) /tuz.da.ra.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
